title: decree emit --format json
description: What `decree emit --format json` prints on stdout: the id and path of a new message for a machine, queued in .decree/inbox/. On failure nothing is printed on stdout; the error goes to stderr and the exit code is 1. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

id.description: The message id, also its run id once it is claimed; text prints only this.

path.description: The queued file, relative to the project root: .decree/inbox/<id>.md.
